problem_meta.instruction: Please provide a feasible product that could be formed using the given reactants and reagents.
problem_meta.agent_answer:
The feasible major product is formed by **LiOH-mediated saponification of the ethyl ester** in aqueous 1,4-dioxane.

### Transformation

\[
\text{–CO}_2\text{Et} \;\longrightarrow\; \text{–CO}_2\text{H}
\]

The oxadiazole ring, hydroxamic-acid group, stereocenter, ether linkage, and cyclohexylbutyl substituent remain unchanged.

### Product SMILES

```text
O=C(O)COCc1noc([C@H](CCCC2CCCCC2)CC(=O)NO)n1
```

An equivalent ring-order representation is:

```text
C1(CCCCC1)CCC[C@H](CC(=O)NO)C1=NC(=NO1)COCC(=O)O
```

The immediate product under basic conditions may be the corresponding **lithium carboxylate**; the neutral carboxylic acid shown above is expected after aqueous acidification/workup. The reported matched conditions were approximately **2 h** with an approximately **95.4% yield**. Supported by `call_kvrEcD1WbhK52LSrFqwl50VS`.
